Our Story

A lifestyle haven, not just a restaurant.

Rue Addis was conceived as Addis Ababa's most refined and culturally rich dining destination — uniquely set within the prestigious CBE Headquarters. More than a place to eat, it is a space where culinary innovation meets cultural elegance and attentive hospitality, four floors above the city.
